criterion.text: Para cada formato importável e cada estado novo persistido, apontar exatamente um produtor e o consumidor real; nenhum aparece como responsabilidade genérica da integração.

method.evidence: Pinned production source inspection only; no local tests, typecheck, bootstrap or native/browser run performed for this matrix.
method.producerDefinition: Exactly one canonical business creation/normalization entrypoint per row; existing update writers do not become alternative producers.
method.consumerDefinition: Exactly one implementation that reads or applies the row in a business flow. Type imports, schema declarations and same-write verification do not substitute for a missing business consumer.
method.familyPartition: A dictionary with several business key families is split. Active and historical records are split when consumers differ.
method.ownership: owner names the bounded business responsibility. pathOwner is derived from ownership-v1.json; null means this mapping does not invent an exact path grant.
method.formatBoundary: For a format row, producer builds the normalized domain input; consumer is the actual domain command/evidence operation. Parser and persistent composition are separate concrete references.
method.acceptanceBoundary: source-mapped means source found, not runtime connected, correct, durable or accepted. No provider acceptance or GNATIVE claim follows.
